name: dconx-agent
description: Local-only coding agent powered by Ollama, with diff-approval and path guardrails.

dconx.ollama.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server.
dconx.ollama.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the Ollama server. Local (`http://127.0.0.1:11434`) or remote (`https://ollama.example.com`). Use the server root — no `/api` or `/v1` suffix.

dconx.ollama.model.description: Ollama model to use. Must support tool calling.

dconx.agent.maxIterations.description: Maximum tool-call rounds per task before the agent stops and asks.

dconx.guard.denyGlobs.description: Glob patterns the agent may never read or write.

dconx.guard.allowGlobs.description: If non-empty, the agent may only touch files matching these globs (deny list still wins).

dconx.guard.maxEditLines.description: Reject any single proposed edit that changes more lines than this.

dconx.guard.maxFileBytes.description: Refuse to read or write files larger than this many bytes.

dconx.guard.allowCreate.description: Allow the agent to propose creating new files.

dconx.guard.allowDelete.description: Allow the agent to propose deleting files. Off by default.

dconx.guard.allowCommands.description: Allow the agent to propose running commands from the allowlist. Every run still requires your approval. Turn off for a read-and-edit-only agent.

dconx.guard.commandAllowlist.markdownDescription: Commands the agent may propose, matched on whole leading tokens (`git log` does not permit `git push`). Shell metacharacters are always rejected.

dconx.guard.commandTimeoutMs.description: Kill an approved command after this many milliseconds.

dconx.guard.commandOutputLimit.description: Characters of command output handed back to the model.

dconx.agent.scratchFolder.description: Workspace-relative folder the agent offers for throwaway work, such as a new project scaffold you are only trying out. Must not start with a dot.

dconx.guard.autoApproveCreate.markdownDescription: Write **new** files without asking for approval, so scaffolding a project does not become a dozen identical clicks. Each auto-created file is listed in the panel with an Undo button. Editing an **existing** file always requires approval and is never affected by this setting.

dconx.ollama.apiKey.markdownDescription: Bearer token for a remote Ollama server. Leave empty for a local one. **Stored in plain text in settings.json** — prefer the `OLLAMA_API_KEY` environment variable, which takes precedence over this.

dconx.ollama.headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every request, for gateways that need their own.

dconx.ollama.requestTimeoutMs.description: Give up on a request that has produced no response in this many milliseconds. Raise it for a big model on a slow remote host.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run check && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out dconx-agent.vsix
